transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because... people in my apartment building keep watching when I come and go. I think they’re leaving notes about me with the office. Everyone says they’re just notices on the doors, but... I don’t think that’s all it is.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or wired lately?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t felt wired or anything like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
I don’t know… not really. I mean, I haven’t noticed voices like that.
Have people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Sometimes, yeah. People say I’m not making sense. I’ll try to explain one thing, like the rent, and then I end up talking about the marina, or choir robes, or the wires in the walls… and they look at me like I left parts out.
Have there been times when you felt so unusually good or irritable that you needed much less sleep than usual?
No… I don’t think so. My sleep’s not great sometimes, but not because I felt real good or keyed up like that.
Do you believe anyone is controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?

I don’t know about controlling my thoughts… but I do know people in my apartment are watching when I come and go. They slip notes about me to the office. Everybody says they’re just notices on the doors, but… I don’t think that’s all it is.
About how long have you been feeling that people in your apartment building are watching you and leaving notes about you?
I guess… a little over a year now. Maybe about a year and a month.
During this past year, have you had a period of depression that lasted at least two weeks?
Yeah… it’s been more than two weeks. That heavy, no-point feeling… pulling away from things… it’s been going on maybe a year and a couple months.
Have there been times when you still felt people were watching you or leaving notes about you even when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… there was a stretch, a few weeks maybe, where I wasn’t feeling quite as bad. I was eating a little better, not waking up so hopeless. But I still thought the neighbors were watching my door… reporting on me.
During this illness, have you been depressed for most of the time?
Yeah… most of it, I’d say. Since I moved, even when I could seem a little more okay, I still felt pretty low… useless, not really interested in things.
Was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when you still believed people were watching you or leaving notes about you, but you were not feeling depressed at all?
Yeah… there was a few weeks like that. I wasn’t waking up so hopeless, and I was eating a little better. But I still thought the neighbors were watching my door… reporting on me.
Have you found yourself talking much less than usual, even when you want to say more?
I’m not sure… I don’t really pay attention to that. I guess I’m quiet a lot, but that’s kind of just how I am.
When you feel depressed, do you ever believe that you deserve bad things to happen to you?
I don’t know… I mean, I feel bad about myself sometimes. But “deserve bad things”… I’m not sure I’d put it that way.
When you feel depressed, do you believe the neighbors are watching you because you’ve done something wrong or deserve to be punished?

I don’t know if it’s punishment exactly. I just… I know the people in my building are watching when I come and go, and there’s notes getting slipped to the office about me. People say they’re just regular notices on the doors, but it doesn’t feel that way.
Have people told you that your face looks blank or that you show very little emotion?
I don’t know… nobody’s really said that to me, not that I remember. I don’t pay much attention to my face.
Have you lost motivation to do everyday things, like showering, cleaning, or getting things done?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to go to choir practice, play bridge, cook on Sundays… help people with little repairs. Now I mostly just let the phone ring and tell myself there’s no point going.
Even during times when you were not feeling depressed, did you still have very little motivation to do everyday things?
I’m not really sure. I mean… even when I’m not feeling that low, I don’t always do much. But I don’t know if that’s the same thing or just me being tired of everything.
When you were not feeling depressed, did other people still notice that your face looked blank or showed very little emotion?
I… I don’t really know. Nobody’s told me that, not that I can think of. I don’t usually ask people how my face looks.
When you were not feeling depressed, did you still feel emotionally flat or unable to show much feeling?
I don’t know… I don’t really think about it that way. Maybe sometimes I’m quiet, but I can’t say if I felt flat when I wasn’t depressed.
Was there ever a full month when you still believed the neighbors were watching you or leaving notes about you, but you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… I think so. There was a stretch, maybe several weeks, where I wasn’t waking up feeling so hopeless, and I was eating a little better. But I still thought the neighbors were watching my door… like they were reporting on me.
